title: Internal Hom commutes with etale restriction
statement: Let f : Y → X be an etale morphism of schemes, Lambda a commutative ring, and F,G sheaves of Lambda-modules on X_et. There is an isomorphism f^* internalHom(F,G) ≅ internalHom(f^*F,f^*G), with internal Hom for the sheafified objectwise tensor product. No finiteness hypothesis is imposed on F,G or Lambda.

source.place: IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.ihom_unit docstring, local finite presentation argument

proof.text: Identify the small etale site of Y with the localization of X_et at the object Y. Under this equivalence f^* is the restriction functor; the existing overSheafEquivFunctorObjOverIso supplies this identification for every sheaf.

On a site the sections of the module-valued internal Hom at U are Hom(F|U,G|U). To establish this for the chosen closed structure, apply the tensor-Hom adjunction to the free module sheaf on the representable U: maps out of it evaluate sections, while maps out of its tensor product with F are morphisms F|U → G|U. These identifications are linear and natural in U.

The iterated localization (X_et/Y)/U is equivalent to X_et/U. Thus the section modules of restriction of internalHom(F,G) and internalHom(F|Y,G|Y) agree. The maps along U′ → U are restrictions of the same sheaf morphisms, so these identifications form a natural isomorphism of module sheaves. Transport it back along the site equivalence of step 1.

theorem nonempty_etale_upperStar_ihom_iso (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    (F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj ((ihom F).obj G) ≅
      (ihom ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj F)).obj
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj G))
